method: human transcription from 400 DPI rendered crop, cross-checked against tessdata_best/std OCR drafts; poetry and severely ambiguous glyphs re-examined at 700 DPI
normalization: Unicode NFC + whitespace collapse; original orthography preserved (no hamza/case modernization, no diacritic removal)
scope: contiguous prose region per page (the poem on p20 was excluded; p169 includes a poem because it is inseparable from the passage)
note: GT is human-verified but not perfect; per-page uncertainty is listed. CER should be read with that caveat.
